## `dcc_rest_result_clone`

Creates an owned deep copy of a full version-1 result. out is set to NULL before validation and on every failure. The clone owns exact body_len bytes (including embedded NULs) and its decoded message.

```c
DCC_API dcc_status_t dcc_rest_result_clone( const dcc_rest_result_t *source, dcc_rest_result_t **out );
```

## `dcc_rest_result_free`

Releases a result returned by dcc_rest_result_clone(); NULL is allowed.

```c
DCC_API void dcc_rest_result_free(dcc_rest_result_t *result);
```

